# Statistical analysis

Load the analysis functions and Hoebeke ESM dataset.

```{r load-data}
source("Analyses/functions.R")
hoebeke <- load_hoebeke_data("0013_hoebeke")
data <- prepare_observation_order(hoebeke$data)
rating_variables <- get_rating_variables(data)
```

Show dataset size and descriptive statistics.

```{r descriptives}
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Characteristic = c("Participants", "Observations", "Rating variables"),
  Value = c(dplyr::n_distinct(data$id), nrow(data), length(rating_variables))
))

knitr::kable(
  get_descriptive_stats(data, variables = rating_variables),
  digits = 2
)
```

Show missingness and the negativity distribution.

```{r missingness-and-distribution, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
missingness <- get_missingness(data)
knitr::kable(missingness[missingness$variable %in% rating_variables, ], digits = 2)
plot_distribution(data, variable = "negativity")
```

Fit the multilevel regression and display its coefficients.

```{r multilevel-model}
multilevel_results <- fit_multilevel_model(
  data = data,
  outcome = "negativity",
  predictors = c("perseverance", "self_criticism", "brooding", "replaying"),
  include_day = TRUE,
  random_slope = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  multilevel_results$fixed_effects[, c("term", "estimate", "std.error", "conf.low", "conf.high")],
  digits = 3
)
```

Plot the regression coefficients and 95% confidence intervals.

```{r coefficient-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
plot_coefficient_estimates(multilevel_results$fixed_effects)
```

# Forecasting app

```{r launch-shiny-app, eval=FALSE}
shiny::runApp("app")
```
